evidence.observation: Growth-entry temperature overshoot to 760.6 °C with heater power reduced to 39.7%; subsequent readings settle near the 750 °C setpoint.
Temperature 749.8 °C versus 750 °C setpoint, heater power 44.5%, argon 99.6 sccm versus 100 sccm setpoint, and status running; consistent with stable growth execution.
Pressure and exhaust oxygen sensors are not installed; null readings are expected rather than evidence of a fault.
